## Où j'en suis
At the end of the last session (Nov 17), real SAML login works end to end on staging against Fernhill's IdP on branch `daniel/saml-sso-fernhill`: JIT provisioning from #415 (merged) creates users as `viewer`, and the short-RelayState fix plus per-tenant group→role mapping sit in PR #421, still open. The one thing blocking the Thursday Nov 19, 10:00 ET demo is Fernhill IT adding the `groups` claim, which Daniel is emailing them about; contract go-live is Dec 1. (source: ses-sso-3, kestrel-analytics/platform#421, src-linear-kes311)

- [en-cours] PR #421 "SAML: group to role mapping + short RelayState" is open, not merged; per-tenant `saml_role_mapping` applied on every login, not only at creation (source: kestrel-analytics/platform#421, f4a91c7, ses-sso-3)
- [prochaine-étape] Fernhill IT adds the groups claim, then an admin test account next to `kestrel.test1`, before the Thursday demo (source: s3-08, src-linear-kes311)
- [essai-raté] sending the full return URL as RelayState (143 bytes) was rejected by Fernhill's ADFS with `MSIS7042`, the binding spec caps RelayState at 80 bytes (source: s3-02)
- [décision] short opaque RelayState: 16-byte ID in Redis under `saml:rs:<id>`, TTL 600 s, deleted on use (source: s3-03, 6d0e2b8)
- [décision] `viewer` stays the default role and SP-initiated login stays on; Fernhill's Slack request for an `analyst` default and IdP-initiated only is declined (source: s3-07, src-slack-fernhill)
- [décision] JIT creates a user only from a verified domain, never from an unverified one (source: s2-03)
- [décision] SAML only for Fernhill, no OIDC for now (source: s1-03)
- [décision] users created at first login get the `viewer` role (source: s1-05)
